title: 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자 규정 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: Ministry of National Defense ( Personnel Policy Division ), 02-748-5132
rows.text_en: Ministry of National Defense (Personnel Policy Division), 02-748-5132

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the "Regulations on Eligibility for Additional Military Service Support Payments" and matters necessary for their implementation. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters delegated by the Regulations on Persons Eligible for Military Additional-Service Support Payments and other matters necessary for their enforcement. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: [Wholly Amended Aug. 1, 2011]
rows.text_en: [Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Selection Plan) ① The Chiefs of Staff of the Army, Navy, and Air Force (including the Marine Corps; hereinafter referred to as “each service”) (in the case of the Marine Corps, the Commandant of the Marine Corps; hereinafter referred to as “Chiefs of Staff of each service”) shall prepare a selection plan for recipients of the additional military service support allowance for the following year by February 28 of each year and obtain the approval of the Minister of National Defense. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Selection Plans) ① The Chiefs of Staff of the Army, Navy, and Air Force, including the Marine Corps (in the case of the Marine Corps, its Commandant; hereinafter referred to as the "Chiefs of Staff of each service"), shall prepare a plan for selecting recipients of Military Additional-Service Support Payments for the following year by Feb. 28 each year and obtain approval from the Minister of National Defense. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② The selection plan for recipients of the additional military service support allowance under Paragraph 1 shall include the following matters: <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>
rows.text_en: ② A selection plan under paragraph (1) shall include the following matters. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. Number of Selected Candidates and Budget
rows.text_en: 1. Number of persons to be selected and required budget

rows.source_ko: 2. Selection Method and Timing
rows.text_en: 2. Selection method and timing

rows.source_ko: 3. Educational institution, curriculum, major field, and duration of study
rows.text_en: 3. Educational institutions, curricula, fields of major study, and maximum duration of studies

rows.source_ko: 4. Other matters deemed necessary
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters deemed necessary

rows.source_ko:
[Wholly Amended Aug. 1, 2011]
[Title Amended Jan. 22, 2018]
rows.text_en:
[Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]
[Title amended on Jan. 22, 2018.]

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Selection Committee for Recipients of Military Service Support Grants) ① A Selection Committee for Recipients of Military Service Support Grants shall be established in the headquarters of each military branch to conduct the selection process for recipients of the Military Service Support Grant and to recommend the results to the Chiefs of Staff of each military branch. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Selection Committees for Recipients of Military Additional-Service Support Payments) ① A selection committee shall be established at the headquarters of each service to conduct selection examinations for payment recipients and recommend the results to the respective Chief of Staff. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② Matters necessary for the organization and operation of the Selection Committee for Recipients of Military Service Support Allowances under Paragraph 1 shall be determined by the Chiefs of Staff of each military branch. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>
rows.text_en: ② Matters necessary for the composition and operation of each selection committee under paragraph (1) shall be determined by the Chief of Staff of the relevant service. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko:
[Wholly Amended Aug. 1, 2011]
[Title Amended Jan. 22, 2018]
rows.text_en:
[Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]
[Title amended on Jan. 22, 2018.]

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Notice of Selection) The Chiefs of Staff of each military branch shall, in accordance with the selection plan for recipients of the additional military service support allowance, announce matters concerning the selection of recipients of the additional military service support allowance at least 30 days prior to the conduct of the selection process. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Public Notice of Selection) Each Chief of Staff shall publicly announce matters concerning selection of recipients of Military Additional-Service Support Payments under the applicable selection plan at least 30 days before the selection examination. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: [Wholly Amended Aug. 1, 2011]
rows.text_en: [Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: Article 5 (Application) ① Any person who wishes to apply as a recipient of the Military Additional Service Support Grant shall submit the Application for Recipient of the Military Additional Service Support Grant ( Form No. 1 ) to the Chief of Staff of each military branch through the head of the relevant school, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs (including electronic documents). <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Applications) ① A person wishing to apply as a recipient of Military Additional-Service Support Payments shall submit an application in Form No. 1 to the Chief of Staff of the relevant service through the head of their school, attaching the following documents (including electronic documents). <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. One copy of the Pledge Form (Attached Form No. 2 ) for Recipients of Additional Military Service Support Payment
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the written pledge for recipients of Military Additional-Service Support Payments in Form No. 2

rows.source_ko: 2. One copy of the background check confirmation report issued by the Head of the District Office, Mayor, Town Head, or Township Head
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of a background inquiry confirmation report issued by the competent District Head, Mayor, Eup Head, or Myeon Head

rows.source_ko: 3. One copy each of the academic transcript (entrance exam scores for new students) and the ranking list.
rows.text_en: 3. One copy each of the academic transcript (entrance examination results for newly admitted students) and the ranking list

rows.source_ko: 4. One letter of recommendation from the school principal
rows.text_en: 4. One letter of recommendation from the school principal

rows.source_ko: 5. One copy of the Application for Payment of Additional Military Service Support Allowance (Form No. 3 )
rows.text_en: 5. One application for payment of Military Additional-Service Support Payments in Form No. 3

rows.source_ko: 6. One copy of a guarantee insurance policy issued by an insurance company pursuant to the Insurance Business Act
rows.text_en: 6. One guarantee insurance policy issued by an insurance company under the Insurance Business Act

rows.source_ko: ② The public official in charge who receives the application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the contents of the resident registration abstract through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant shall be required to attach a resident registration abstract or a basic certificate.
rows.text_en: ② The official receiving the application under paragraph (1) shall verify the applicant's abstract of resident registration through shared administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act. If the applicant does not consent to verification, the official shall require an abstract of resident registration or a basic certificate to be attached.

rows.source_ko: [Wholly Amended Aug. 1, 2011]
rows.text_en: [Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: Article 6 (Selection) ① Upon receiving applications pursuant to Article 5, the Chiefs of Staff of each military branchshall conduct physical examinations, interviews, and other screening procedures to select candidates for the payment of additional military service support funds or to make recommendations for selection. However, for schools where a Reserve Officers' Training Corps (ROTC) is established, the ROTC may conduct the screening procedures. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Selection) ① Upon receipt of an application under Article 5, the Chiefs of Staff shall conduct a physical examination, interview, or other selection process and select payment recipients or recommend candidates for selection. However, in a school with a Reserve Officers' Training Corps, the Corps may conduct the selection process. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② The Chiefs of Staff of each military branch shall notify persons selected as recipients of the additional military service support allowance of such fact through the head of the relevant school, and shall report the selection status of recipients of the additional military service support allowance to the Minister of National Defense in accordance with Form No. 4. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>
rows.text_en: ② The Chiefs of Staff shall notify selected persons through the heads of their schools and report the selection status of payment recipients to the Minister of National Defense using Form No. 4. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ③ When the Minister of National Defense or the Chiefs of Staff of each military branch select or cancel the selection of recipients for the additional military service support allowance, they shall notify the Commissioner of the Military Manpower Administration of the list thereof. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>
rows.text_en: ③ Where the Minister of National Defense or a Chief of Staff selects payment recipients or cancels their selection, the official shall notify the Commissioner of the Military Manpower Administration of the list. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

[Title Amended Jan. 22, 2018]
rows.text_en:

[Title amended on Jan. 22, 2018.]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(결원의 보충) ① 각군 참모총장은 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자의 사망, 퇴학, 선발취소 등으로 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자에 결원이 생겼을 때에는 국방부장관의 승인을 받아 그 결원을 보충할 수 있다. 다만, 「군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자 규정」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제4조제1항제2호에 해당하는 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자에 결원이 생겼을 때에는 각군 참모총장이 그 결원을 보충할 수 있다. <개정 2018. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Filling Vacancies) ① Where a vacancy arises among payment recipients because of death, withdrawal from school, cancellation of selection, or a similar cause, the Chiefs of Staff may fill it with approval from the Minister of National Defense. However, where the vacancy involves a recipient under Article 4 (1) 2 of the Regulations on Persons Eligible for Military Additional-Service Support Payments (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree"), the Chief of Staff may fill the vacancy without that approval. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 결원을 보충할 때에는 제5조와 제6조를 준용하되, 그 결원 전의 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자와 같은 학년의 재학생 중에서 보충하는 것을 원칙으로 한다. <개정 2018. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: ② Articles 5 and 6 shall apply mutatis mutandis to filling vacancies under paragraph (1). As a rule, a vacancy shall be filled by a currently enrolled student in the same grade as the former recipient. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>
[Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(협약학교) 국방부장관은 영 제6조제1항에 따라 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자를 선발할 학교를 위촉하고, 각군 참모총장은 위촉된 학교(이하 “협약학교”라 한다)의 장과 같은 조 제2항에 따라 그 선발 및 교육에 관한 다음 각 호의 사항에 대하여 협약을 체결한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Agreement Schools) The Minister of National Defense shall designate schools for selection of payment recipients under Article 6 (1) of the Decree, and the Chiefs of Staff shall conclude agreements with the heads of those schools (hereinafter referred to as "agreement schools") under Article 6 (2) concerning the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 목적
rows.text_en: 1. Purpose

rows.source_ko: 2. 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자 선발계획에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Selection plans for payment recipients

rows.source_ko: 3. 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자의 교육과정 및 그 실시에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Educational curricula for payment recipients and implementation thereof

rows.source_ko: 4. 군 가산복무 지원금 지급에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning payment of Military Additional-Service Support Payments

rows.source_ko: 5. 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자의 학업성적, 상벌, 수학 상황 등의 통보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Notification of recipients' academic achievement, awards and disciplinary measures, study status, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자의 선발취소 통보와 결원보충에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Notification of cancellation of selection and filling of vacancies

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자의 교육에 필요하다고 인정되는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters deemed necessary for the education of payment recipients
[Wholly amended on Jan. 22, 2018.]
Article 9 Deleted <Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 제10조(협약학교의 위촉 해지) ① 국방부장관은 협약학교에 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사유가 발생하였을 경우에는 협약학교의 위촉을 해지할 수 있다. <개정 2018. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Termination of Designation of Agreement Schools) ① The Minister of National Defense may terminate the designation of an agreement school if any of the following grounds arises. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 학교가 폐쇄되거나 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자에 관한 교육과정이 폐지된 경우
rows.text_en: 1. The school closes, or its educational curriculum for recipients of Military Additional-Service Support Payments is abolished

rows.source_ko: 2. 협약사항을 위반한 경우
rows.text_en: 2. The school violates an agreement

rows.source_ko: 3. 군의 인력 조정상 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자가 필요하지 아니하게 된 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Recipients are no longer needed because of military manpower adjustments

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 협약학교의 위촉이 해지된 학교에 재학 중인 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자에 대해서는 계속 그 자격을 인정한다. 다만, 제1항제1호의 사유에 해당하는 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자의 자격에 대해서는 국방부장관이 따로 정한다. <개정 2018. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: ② The qualifications of payment recipients enrolled at a school whose designation has been terminated under paragraph (1) shall continue to be recognized. However, where the reason for termination falls under paragraph (1) 1, the Minister of National Defense shall separately determine the qualifications of those recipients. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>
[Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(지급) ① 영 제7조에 따라 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자에게 수학기간 중 생활비를 지원하기 위하여 「고등교육법」 제11조제1항에 따른 등록금에 해당하는 금액을 군 가산복무 지원금으로 지급한다. <개정 2014. 12. 31., 2018. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Payment) ① To support recipients' living expenses while they study, Military Additional-Service Support Payments equal to tuition fees under Article 11 (1) of the Higher Education Act shall be paid under Article 7 of the Decree. <Amended Dec. 31, 2014; Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② 협약학교의 장은 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자로부터 군 가산복무 지원금 지급신청서를 받았을 때에는 별지 제5호서식에 따른 총괄표를 작성ㆍ첨부하여 각군 참모총장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: ② On receiving an application for payment from a recipient, the head of an agreement school shall prepare and attach a summary statement in Form No. 5 and submit it to the Chief of Staff of the relevant service. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ③ 군 가산복무 지원금은 각군 참모총장이 학교의 장을 거쳐 본인에게 한꺼번에 지급하거나 학기별 또는 분기별로 지급한다. <개정 2018. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Chief of Staff of the relevant service shall pay Military Additional-Service Support Payments to the recipient through the head of the school, either in a lump sum or by semester or quarter. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

[Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]
[Title amended on Jan. 22, 2018.]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(성적) 영 제12조제1항에 따른 “우수한 성적으로 마친 사람”은 수학 기간 중 각 과목의 평균 성적이 100분의 90 이상 또는 성적 서열이 100분의 5 이내인 사람으로 하며, 영 제13조제3호에 따른 “성적이 현저히 불량한 경우”는 학기 말 평균 성적이 100분의 70 미만인 경우로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Academic Performance) The phrase “completed with excellent grades” in Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Decree refers to a person whose average score for each subject during the study period is at least 90 percent or whose academic rank is within the top five percent. The phrase “significantly poor academic performance” in Article 13, subparagraph 3 of the Decree refers to an average score below 70 percent at the end of the semester.
[Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: 제13조(반납) ① 각군 참모총장이 영 제15조제1항에 따라 지급된 군 가산복무 지원금을 반납하게 하는 경우에는 별지 제6호서식에 따른 군 가산복무 지원금 반납 통지서를 본인 또는 그의 친권자 및 보험회사에게 보내야 한다. 이 경우 납입기한은 반납 통지일부터 6개월 이내로 한다. <개정 2018. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Return of Payments) ① Where the Chief of Staff of the relevant service requires repayment of Military Additional-Service Support Payments under Article 15 (1) of the Decree, the Chief shall send a notice of return in Form No. 6 to the recipient or the person exercising parental authority over the recipient and the insurance company. The payment deadline shall fall within six months after the date of the notice. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제15조제2항 전단에 따라 받은 군 가산복무 지원금의 반납을 연기하거나 면제받으려는 사람은 반납 통지일부터 1개월 이내에 별지 제7호서식에 따른 군 가산복무 지원금 반납 연기(면제) 신청서를 소속 군 참모총장에게 제출하여야 한다. 이 경우 반납 연기기간은 반납 통지일부터 1년 이내로 한다. <개정 2018. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: ② A person seeking deferral of, or exemption from, return of payments under the first sentence of Article 15 (2) of the Decree shall submit an application in Form No. 7 to the Chief of Staff of the relevant service within one month after receiving the notice to return the payments. Any period of deferral shall be within one year of the date of the notice. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

[Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]
[Title amended on Jan. 22, 2018.]

rows.source_ko: 제14조(반납의 면제) 영 제15조제2항 전단에 따른 반납의 일부 또는 전부 면제는 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자가 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우로 한정한다. <개정 2016. 6. 17., 2018. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Exemption from Return) Exemption from all or part of repayment under the first sentence of Article 15 (2) of the Decree shall be limited to a payment recipient falling under any of the following cases. <Amended Jun. 17, 2016; Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 사망한 경우
rows.text_en: 1. The recipient dies

rows.source_ko: 2. 군 의료기관에서 신체검사를 한 결과 자연재해나 전상(戰傷)ㆍ공상(公傷)으로 인한 심신장애로 장교 또는 부사관으로 임용되거나 복무할 수 없다고 판단된 경우
rows.text_en: 2. A military medical institution determines through physical examination that a recipient cannot be appointed or serve as an officer or noncommissioned officer because of a mental or physical disability caused by a natural disaster, an injury sustained in war, or an injury sustained in the line of duty

rows.source_ko: 3. 임용 후 의무복무기간 중 「군인사법」 제8조에 따른 현역정년에 해당되어 전역한 경우
rows.text_en: 3. After appointment, the recipient is discharged during the obligatory service period upon reaching the retirement age for active-duty military personnel under Article 8 of the Military Personnel Management Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 개인의 고의가 아닌 예측 불가능한 사고나 질병 등으로 인하여 장교 또는 부사관으로 복무할 수 없게 된 경우
rows.text_en: 4. A recipient becomes unable to serve as an officer or noncommissioned officer because of an unforeseeable accident or illness not caused intentionally by that person
[Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: 제15조(귀향처분을 받은 사람에 대한 처리) ① 각군 참모총장은 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자로 입영한 사람으로서 입영신체검사 결과 귀향처분을 받은 사람 중 15일 이상의 치료기간이 필요한 사람에게는 그 처분의 원인이 된 질병 또는 심신장애의 치유기간을 고려하여 해당 군의 다음 입영일에 다시 입영하도록 하여야 한다. 다만, 치유기간이 신체검사일부터 12개월을 초과하는 경우에는 12개월이 되는 달을 전후한 입영일에 다시 입영하게 하여 신체검사를 실시한다. <개정 2018. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Handling of Persons Ordered to Return Home) ① Where a payment recipient who enlisted is ordered to return home after an enlistment physical examination and needs treatment for at least 15 days, the Chief of Staff shall have the person reenlist on the next enlistment date of that service, taking account of the recovery period. However, if the recovery period exceeds 12 months from the physical examination, the person shall reenlist around the month when the 12-month period expires and undergo a physical examination. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 다시 입영한 사람이 신체검사 결과 다시 귀향처분을 받으면 다음 각 호와 같이 처분한다.
rows.text_en: ② Where a person who reenlisted under paragraph (1) is again ordered to return home following a physical examination, the following measures shall apply:

rows.source_ko: 1. 귀향처분을 받은 후 다음 입영일이 최초 신체검사일부터 합산하여 12개월을 초과하는 사람에 대해서는 현역편입처분을 취소한다.
rows.text_en: 1. Where the next enlistment date following the return-home order falls more than 12 months after the initial physical examination, the disposition transferring the person to active-duty service shall be revoked

rows.source_ko: 2. 최초 신체검사일부터 9개월이 지난 후 다시 입영하여 신체검사를 한 결과, 치유기간이 최초 신체검사일부터 합산하여 12개월을 초과할 것으로 인정되는 사람에 대해서는 현역편입처분을 취소한다.
rows.text_en: 2. Where a person reenlists and undergoes a physical examination more than nine months after the first examination and the recovery period is expected to exceed 12 months from the first examination, the disposition transferring the person to active-duty service shall be revoked

rows.source_ko: 3. 제1호나 제2호에 해당하지 않는 사람에 대해서는 해당 군의 다음 입영일에 다시 입영하게 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: 3. A person not falling under subparagraph 1 or 2 shall be required to reenlist on the next enlistment date of the relevant service

rows.source_ko: ③ 입영신체검사 결과 신체등급이 5급 또는 6급인 사람과 제2항제1호 또는 제2호에 따라 현역편입처분이 취소된 사람은 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자의 자격을 상실한다. <개정 2018. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: ③ Persons assigned physical fitness grade 5 or 6 at the enlistment examination, and persons whose transfer to active-duty service is revoked under paragraph (2) 1 or 2, shall lose their qualifications as recipients of Military Additional-Service Support Payments. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>
[Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: 제16조(자격을 상실한 사람에 대한 처리) 각군 참모총장은 제15조제3항에 따라 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자의 자격을 상실한 사람에 대해서는 그 사실을 본인과 병무청장에게 통보하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Handling of Persons Who Lose Eligibility) The Chief of Staff of the relevant service shall notify the person concerned and the Commissioner of the Military Manpower Administration when a person loses eligibility for Military Additional-Service Support Payments under Article 15 (3). <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>

[Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]
[Title amended on Jan. 22, 2018.]

rows.source_ko: 제17조(현황 보고) 각군 참모총장은 매학기 말을 기준으로 하여 그 다음 달 15일까지 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자에 관한 취학, 선발취소 및 졸업인원 현황을 국방부장관에게 보고하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Reports on Status) As of the end of each semester, the Chiefs of Staff shall report the numbers of payment recipients on leave of absence, whose selection has been cancelled, and who have graduated to the Minister of National Defense by the 15th day of the following month. <Amended Jan. 22, 2018>
[Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: 제18조(시행 세칙) 이 규칙의 시행에 필요한 사항은 국방부장관의 승인을 받아 각군 참모총장이 정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Detailed Rules for Enforcement) Matters necessary for enforcing these Rules shall be determined by the Chiefs of Staff with the approval of the Minister of National Defense.
[Wholly amended on Aug. 1, 2011.]

rows.text_en: In Article 8 (3) 12 and Article 18, subparagraph 5, "military scholarship student" shall be replaced with "recipient of Military Additional-Service Support Payments".

rows.source_ko: The title of Article 26, “(Notification and Enlistment, etc. of Selected Military Scholarship Recipients),” shall be changed to “(Notification and Enlistment, etc. of Recipients of Military Additional Service Support Funds),” and in Paragraph 1 of the same article, “military scholarship recipients pursuant to the ‘Military Scholarship Regulations’” shall be changed to “recipients of military additional service support funds pursuant to the ‘Regulations on Recipients of Military Additional Service Support Funds’,” and in Paragraphs 2 through 4 of the same article, “as a military scholarship recipient” shall be changed to “recipients of military additional service support funds,” respectively, and in Paragraph 5 of the same article, “as a military scholarship recipient” shall be changed to “as a recipient of military additional service support funds.”
rows.text_en: In the title of Article 26, "Notification and Enlistment, etc. of Selected Military Scholarship Recipients" shall be replaced with "Notification and Enlistment, etc. of Recipients of Military Additional-Service Support Payments". In paragraph (1), "military scholarship recipients under the Military Scholarship Student Regulations" shall be replaced with "recipients of Military Additional-Service Support Payments under the Regulations on Persons Eligible for Military Additional-Service Support Payments". In paragraphs (2) through (4), "as a military scholarship recipient" shall be replaced with "as a recipient of Military Additional-Service Support Payments", and in paragraph (5) the corresponding singular expression shall be replaced accordingly.
